claims.exact_statement: Let T be a finite physical restriction tree for Boolean f. If every leaf satisfies U<=kappa I and sum_v p_v(Delta_i U-K_i^(0)) <= A sum_v p_v Inf_i + b U(f), for fixed A,kappa>=0 and b<1, then U(f) <= [max(A,kappa) I(f)+(2/ln2)Var(f)]/(1-b), hence H(f) <= [2+2(max(A,kappa)+2/ln2)/(1-b)] I(f). The statement permits the same physical coordinate at incomparable nodes.
claims.first_unproved_line: For every Boolean f, construct a finite physical tree with fixed terminal kappa and prove the aggregate signed residual bound with fixed A and b<1.
